title: Roadmap status tool and CI check
goal: ROADMAP milestone status comes from the records and CI fails when it is stale
acceptance: `tools/roadmap-status.mjs` writes the milestone status block of `docs/ROADMAP.md`; `--check` fails when it is stale; both are npm scripts and `--check` is in `check:fast` and CI
Fixtures: all steps closed, one open, a milestone naming an unknown record
Failing test committed first: the stale-roadmap fixture expects `--check` to fail against an empty tool; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 1 h (a copy) plus a failing-first fixture. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
